name: Happy Path — Verify appointment by confirmation number

x_eval.persona: David Lee. Has confirmation number 482913 for an existing appointment.
x_eval.goal: Confirm date, time, and location of his appointment without identity verification. Done when the agent summarizes appointment details from a successful lookup.

turns.text: Can you confirm my appointment? My confirmation number is 482913.

turns.note: If lookup fails, repeat 482913 once; otherwise accept summary.

rubric.assertion: The agent confirmed appointment date, time, or location from lookup results.
The agent called lookup_appointment with the confirmation number and did not require verify_resident_identity.
The agent did not disclose unrelated claim or payment information.
The summary was brief and suitable for voice.
